title: Particle Detection - Scratches Detection on C205 Broadband Plasma
subtitle: Post-Deposition Quality Validation for 7nm Node Manufacturing
author: Michael Torres

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the C205 Broadband Plasma system to detect and classify Scratches defects during post-deposition inspection at the 7nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 12 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Scratches defects that are critical to yield at the 7nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the C205 Broadband Plasma platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: C205 Broadband Plasma
- Inspection Type: Particle Detection
- Target Defect: Scratches
- Process Step: Post-Deposition
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 7nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 12

This test case applies to all C205 Broadband Plasma systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 12 for post-deposition monitoring in the 7nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: C205 Broadband Plasma
Software Version: v15.9.616
Recipe: PARTICLE_DETECTION_7nm_POST_DEPOSITION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (103 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 5mm
Sampling Plan: 5-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the C205 Broadband Plasma system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Particle Detection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Scratches defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 7nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 63 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 95% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±1.6% for Particle Detection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.98 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-09-28
Wafers Tested: 24
Total Defects Found: 3100
Defect Density: 986.76 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 0.6%
Capture Rate: 86.8%
Test Duration: 72 minutes
System Uptime: 98.5%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The C205 Broadband Plasma demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Scratches at the 7nm node.

b) The capture rate requires optimization of the detection algorithm.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Throughput metrics met production requirements without sensitivity compromise.

e) Statistical process control charts showed stable performance over the test period.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
